dct_title_s: Preliminary satellite-derived flood assessment - Bu’aale District, Middle Juba Region, Somalia - 09 November 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20231105SOM** Status: Increased water extent along the Jubba River Further action(s): continue monitoring Summary of findings: - Increased water extent along the Jubba River observed as of 08 November 2023; - Affected structures and Inundated roads observed in Dujuuma and Banta villages, Bu’aale District, Middle Juba Region as of 08 November 2023.
